what: sonic-rs 0.5.10 accepts invalid JSON in a skipped (ignored) string: Parser::skip_escaped_chars (src/parser.rs:1129) eats the 5 bytes after a `\u` without checking that 4 hex digits follow, so `"\u"83d\ude00"` swallows the closing quote and the whole body still decodes. serde_json refuses it. This is the one blaze-ci failure left in round2 (webhook::tests::sonic_rs_takes_and_refuses_the_payloads_serde_json_did, ping payload with "\u"83d"); the test holds sonic-rs to serde_json and is right. Fix: vendor sonic-rs 0.5.10 as vendor/sonic-rs (with SOURCE.md naming the change) plus `sonic-rs = { path = "vendor/sonic-rs" }` under [patch.'crates-io'] in the root Cargo.toml, and in skip_escaped_chars replace the `Some(b'u')` arm's `self.read.eat(5)` with: eat 1 (the u), then for each of the next 4 bytes require `b.is_ascii_hexdigit()` (else `perr!(self, InvalidEscape)`) and eat it; that is what "full validation" (skip_one(true), used by deserialize_ignored_any) promises. A surrogate pair need not be checked when skipping, as serde_json's ignore_escape does not either. Report it upstream (cloudwego/sonic-rs) too. From tests-engine; reply in the queue, tests-engine reruns nothing (edit-only) but will re-read the next round's log.

history.note: at the coordinator's ask (round 7c): vendor/sonic-rs (0.5.10 + the hex-digit check in Parser::skip_escaped_chars, SOURCE.md), root Cargo.toml: [patch.crates-io] sonic-rs path and vendor/sonic-rs in workspace exclude (its dev-dependencies are not resolved). manifest lint clean.
